My Heart Is Buried in Venice
Tears

songs.album: The Dark Side of the Moon

Super Rich Kids

songs.name: Promise
songs.comments: Some lyrics are a bit cheesy and some are good. I like the section started with "I should get a cigarette." Lyrics in the bridge are a bit excruciating.

Chorus sounds a little too edgy. It seems intentional but I think it's over the top. I generally dislike this structure where it just repeatedly alternates between chorus and rap verses. I do like how the last line concludes his character's story.
songs.name: Almost Famous
Clocks
songs.album: A Rush of Blood to the Head

songs.comments: Lyrics aren't bad but again I wish there was more variance in the second half.
songs.name: Shoot to Thrill

songs.comments: Some of the sections are a little odd. You could argue that the vocal score should be higher.
songs.name: Welcome To The Jungle
Flower
songs.album: Crash Landing on You (Original Television Soundtrack), Pt. 2

songs.name: Wave of You
songs.comments: Lyrics are basic. Pretty repetitive.
The lyrics on this one are a bit basic. "You're a teaser you turn 'em on" is a bit of a clunky line. Arguably could be decreased.
songs.name: Dancing Queen
jar of hearts
songs.comments: Definitely a bit repetitive
It gets a little too upbeat and "poppy" for me later in the song. Kind of kills that beautiful raw emotion you hear in other versions like the one by Jeff Buckley.
songs.name: Hallelujah
Bones
songs.comments: Has the same kind of strange choppy back and forth feeling as believer. I dislike it but that might be just preference. I also don't like the bridge.
Bridge is amazing. It suddenly cuts out after the second chorus for some reason. Chorus is maybe a little repetitive.
songs.name: Do Ya

songs.comments: The way some of the phrases are broken up is maybe a little odd. Pretty interesting how the song gives a very positive outlook on a bad situation. Maybe a little repetitive.
songs.name: 幸福就是

songs.comments: Some of the lyrics, especially in the pre-choruses, are nice. I do feel like the song doesn't build to anything or have an obvious motion and it ends somewhat abruptly. Background is a little basic.
songs.name: double take

songs.comments: That voice is unbelievable, especially at the end after the key change. So hauntingly beautiful. No clear problems with any other part of the song. I might actually prefer the live version though
songs.name: Opera No.2
Hidden In the Sand
songs.comments: Cute song. I don't like the part at the end where they reverse all the audio.
Chorus makes up too much of the song I feel. The timbre of his voice is incredible though. It blends well with the background vocals and the guitar.
songs.name: Until I Found You
In My Own Time
songs.comments: The "la biblioteca donde está" line in the middle is incredibly odd.

songs.name: Cocoa Butter Kisses
songs.artists: Chance the Rapper, VIC MENSA, Twista

songs.name: Lovely Day
songs.comments: I like the few unique lyrics that exist but it honestly is far too repetitive

songs.album: News Of The World (Deluxe Remastered Version)
songs.name: It's Late - Remastered 2011

songs.comments: I don't like some parts of the vocals (you can hear a lot of breath and air) but it's hard to deny that he's a very good singer. Lots of unique lyrics and the translation looks good. This song probably deserves a higher score.
songs.name: End of a day
The Nights
songs.comments: Could just be my headphones but the bass sounds so high and weak on this. Lyrics are pretty inspirational but the line "my father told me" isn't impactful enough for the place it's in

songs.name: The Crystal Ship
songs.comments: Putting different parts on different sides has an interesting effect but it does feel a bit lacking in the left ear. The lyrics sound poetic but are a bit nonsensical. I'm tempted to increase the vocal score because his voice has such a unique quality.

songs.name: Beep Beep
songs.comments: Lyrics are repetitive and crass but vocals are good. Bridge is pretty meh.
Maybe a little repetitive. Vocals in some spots are definitely better but not throughout the whole song. Cohesion and background at the end are better but also not throughout.
songs.name: Wake Me Up Before You Go-Go
Back In The U.S.S.R. - Remastered 2009
songs.comments: I like the bridge a lot

songs.name: Moonlight Drive
songs.comments: I'm a little biased with this song admittedly. I really like the line starting with "you reach your hand to hold me." The energy of the song increases throughout. One of the best implementations of having different parts in different ears.

songs.name: '39 - Remastered 2011
songs.album: A Night At The Opera (Deluxe Remastered Version)

songs.name: When I Was Your Man
songs.comments: Bridge is outstanding and the final chorus concludes the song well. Some of the sections have vocals that are so unique and flawless I can't begin to imagine executing them. The section between "I was wrong" and "Oh, I know" is genuinely mind blowing.

songs.name: The Box
songs.album: Please Excuse Me for Being Antisocial

songs.comments: Once again the chorus takes up so much of the song. I also just don't feel like the song has an overall direction
songs.name: Starman - 2012 Remaster
songs.album: The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars (2012 Remaster)

songs.name: Bewitched
songs.comments: The song clearly builds throughout. Some really nice lyrics in here like "this all-consuming fire fuming" but also some weaker ones like "what's going on" which doesn't sound right.

songs.name: Believer
songs.comments: Small nitpick, I don't like the overlap of the word pain between "heartache from the pain" to the chorus. Instrumental is very basic until the end and I kind of just don't like the sudden back and forth motion between the chorus and the verses.

songs.artists: Jessie J, Ariana Grande, Nicki Minaj
songs.name: Bang Bang
songs.comments: Very impressive vocals actually. Lyrics are crass but that's very consistent with the rest of the song and some of the lines are pretty creative.

songs.name: Crazy Little Thing Called Love - Remastered 2011
Stereo Hearts (feat. Adam Levine)
songs.comments: A huge portion of the song is dominated by choruses but all of the parts transition into each other pretty well so I didn't deduct.
I didn't deduct too much from the lyrics or flow despite the extreme repetition because he varies the way he sings them throughout.
songs.name: My Sweet Lord - Remastered 2014
Butterflies
songs.comments: The peak in the second verse is incredible. Main criticism is how often the chorus repeats, especially at the end. Just not a very strong ending.

songs.name: 味道
songs.comments: The background does build. I still would've preferred some new lyrics and a bit more of a climax.
Lyrics are a little basic but I didn't deduct. I deducted from flow because it was a bit repetitive and I didn't like how it just ended on another chorus.
songs.name: Shot In The Dark

songs.comments: Gun violence is a serious topic but I can't help but find some of the lyrics to be extremely funny. Chorus is a little repetitive, transition out of the instrumental is a bit sudden and the outro doesn't conclude very well.
songs.name: Put Out The Fire - Remastered 2011
Perfect
songs.comments: I like how all the repeated verses have slightly different lyrics. Lyrics are a little cheesy.
Reduced flow score because the song seems to meander a bit towards the end.
songs.name: Doo Wop (That Thing)

songs.comments: Maybe a few too many repeats of "getting to the point." Lyrics generally are pretty good though.
songs.name: Getting to the Point
Redbone
songs.comments: An incredibly recognizable instrumental. Gets a bit repetitive towards the second half.

songs.name: Sweet Talkin' Woman
songs.comments: The vast majority of the song is composed of choruses or pre-choruses. There's an unnaturally sharp cut between "no, no, no" and "don't know what I'm gonna do" the first time.

songs.name: Sorry Not Sorry
songs.comments: Not a lot going on in the background. Vocals are hard to place because they stick out so much it's a bit grating but she has good technique and range. I found it a bit repetitive.

songs.name: Safe & Sound - from The Hunger Games Soundtrack
songs.comments: It's not quite as bad as it looks but having "ooh" be pretty much the only lyric in the second half isn't great.
songs.album: The Hunger Games: Songs From District 12 And Beyond

songs.name: 4:00A.M.
songs.comments: Instrumental is amazing. Not sure if I like the refrain, it interrupts the flow of the song and suddenly drops the energy. I think her vocals could've used just a bit more energy and emotion. Not a lot in the lyrics. An outro would be nice.
Flow is barely passable. There is building in the background and some variation but still the chorus is repetitive.
songs.name: the words

songs.comments: The song actually builds well to the climax. There's a consistent motion throughout the song too. Everything fits together really well during the peaks at the chorus. The repeated sections have their differences too. Bridge is also good.
songs.name: Enchanted
Under Pressure - Remastered 2011
songs.comments: Overall a pretty odd song with some really good parts. A little all over the place between the scatting, switching singers and different sections. Very hard to score any part of this song.
As I'm noticing with many songs, the lyrics fall off in the second half. The slight variations in execution help a bit.
songs.name: Saturday Night’s Alright (For Fighting) - Remastered 2014

songs.comments: I'm not a fan of this structure rap songs use where they feature an artist to do the repetitive chorus and do all the distinct verses. This is a slightly better example. This one actually follows a consistent theme.
songs.name: Love The Way You Lie

songs.comments: Lyrics are a bit repetitive but the delivery is different.
songs.name: Gloria

songs.comments: I feel that during the climax of the song the instrumental gets so overwhelming that it takes away the solemn vibe from the start of the song
songs.name: Talking to the Moon
I Go to Extremes
songs.comments: Vocals are a little underwhelming, I wish he gave it as much as he did in the outro for the rest of the song. I love how many unique verses there are, generally I like the lyrics. The piano solos are really good.

songs.name: comethru
songs.comments: Might just be a preference but I really don't like these vocals. I don't like how some parts just suddenly cut off and it doesn't sound very well supported. I don't like how the song builds as if it's going to climax then just drops.

songs.name: Take Me to Church
songs.comments: Slightly repetitive chorus

songs.name: Rolling in the Deep
songs.comments: I think the choruses get a little louder each time but it's not super obvious. There's a bit of movement in the background too but I still feel it's not quite enough. It's debatable whether or not the flow score should've been lowered.

songs.name: Past Lives
songs.comments: Intro is very good. Some lyrics like "golden eagle" and "queen of hearts" feel a bit random because they don't seem to be connected to one theme. The chorus feels a bit out of place. Background, lyrics and cohesion could be scored lower.

songs.name: Home
songs.album: The World From The Side Of The Moon
songs.comments: Very few unique lyrics on this one. A lot of "ooh" and "ahh." The lyrics that are there are pretty good though. The choruses are literally identical though.
Not sure if it's just my headphones but the percussive sounds are way to loud and stick out. Four repetitions of the chorus is a lot. The first and last are different I guess.
songs.name: The Lazy Song

songs.album: We Sing. We Dance. We Steal Things.
songs.comments: Lyrics are lighthearted and whimsical which matches with the song. The outro is great, background vocals especially feel like the missing piece.
songs.name: I'm Yours
Tous les mêmes
songs.comments: Also has an amazing music video. I think on paper the structure with 3 different verses from 2 different perspectives moving into "all the same" at the end is cool. The execution feels a bit flat.

songs.name: ゆめうつつ
songs.comments: Don't understand the lyrics but I like the translation and they're all distinct which I like. Flow is a bit unique, the song is split by the temporary pause and there's a shift. It makes the song feel less "together" but the mood change is also interesting.
I think in the intro it would be better if they started lower and went up in the "you"s. The transition between the different parts is pretty cool.
songs.name: Band On The Run - 2010 Remaster
Five Years - 2012 Remaster
songs.album: The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars (2012 Remaster)

songs.name: People Are Strange
songs.comments: Lyrics are a little odd but the real problem is that there are only two real verses that just get repeated. The delivery is changed and the flow of the song has a clear shape.

songs.name: Payphone
songs.comments: Rap verse makes no sense in the context of the song. It talks about how much money he has and how many cars he has but the character in the rest of the song is miserable and doesn't even have enough money for the "payphone."
It's a little all over the place but I love the raw energy, especially in the vocals.
songs.name: You Make Me Real
Secrets
songs.comments: I don't like how it ends by just repeating the chorus more.
I like how the last chorus is changed and how the last line calls back to the first.
songs.name: Apologize

songs.comments: I feel like he's a little flat at some points? There's a really funny sound effect that plays after the second "so beat it, just beat it." Ending on repeated choruses feels lazy. Lyrics aren't great, like "showin' how funky and strong is you fight."
songs.name: Beat It
About Damn Time
songs.comments: I like the bass a lot. Lyrics aren't great, generally crass or basic.
I absolutely love this intro. Bridge is a little random. The repeats of the chorus generally have small differences which is nice.
songs.name: Turn to Stone
Don't Walk Away
songs.comments: The first half flows really well with the two unique verses but it repeats the post chorus too many times at the end I feel.
Lyrics are a bit nonsensical but honestly it would probably work no matter what he was shouting
songs.name: Roadhouse Blues

songs.comments: The music video for this song is incredible. The artist clearly has an emotional connection to what he's singing about. I love how it shifts from confusion to anger to sadness then climaxes and then reaches acceptance
songs.name: Papaoutai
So Fine
songs.comments: "I want it so fine" is a pretty weird line, and the chorus is just that one line being repeated. The instrumental section is also pretty odd.

songs.name: Silhouette
songs.comments: I like a lot of parts of this song but I feel that his voice doesn't quite fit. I like pretty much all the lyrics except "I watch the summer stars to lead me home" which feels less related. It could be something personal to him. Each chorus peaks higher.

songs.name: Thinking out Loud
songs.comments: Could maybe argue vocals can go up. The variation in the pre-chorus was nice and the final chorus is different so I didn't take away from flow. Bridge wasn't too inspiring though
Gorgeous background. Creates such powerful emotions. Clear lows and highs throughout. Maybe a slight criticism that the low high low high low high low high pattern can start to wear a bit.
songs.name: Us and Them
songs.album: The Dark Side of the Moon

songs.comments: I'm biased because I like this song. It's weird, unconventional, and just sounds really fun. You could say lyrics like "there is water at the bottom of the ocean" are nonsensical. The story in the lyrics also definitely isn't as happy as the song sounds.
songs.name: Once in a Lifetime

songs.album: The Best Of The Decca Years Volume One: The Singer
songs.name: La vie en rose - Single Version
From The Start
songs.comments: Lyrics don't fit super well with the mood of the song in my opinion

I really like all the little piano riffs in the background. Maybe slight criticism that there are no lyrics in the scat/instrumental bridge which is the only thing between the repeated chorus but the second chorus has a different mood compared to the first.
songs.name: Dance With You Tonight
CAN'T STOP THE FEELING! (from DreamWorks Animation's "TROLLS")
songs.comments: The bass does a lot for this song. The parts all fit well with the upbeat theme. Very repetitive stuff though, the refrain, pre-chorus, chorus and post-chorus all are almost one to one.
In the middle of the last chorus it randomly gets really muffled for some reason?
songs.name: Hall of Fame (feat. will.i.am)

songs.comments: First verse has good lyrics but most of the rest are repetitive and mediocre. Nothing too wrong with the vocals but they're just a bit boring. Instrument break and the bridge feel a bit out of place.
songs.name: All Dead, All Dead - Remastered 2011
songs.album: News Of The World (Deluxe Remastered Version)

songs.comments: Background vocals are really nice when you listen closely. Incredible lyrics in the unique verses and the bridge. I think there's at least one additional part every time the chorus comes back as well.
songs.name: Take Me Home, Country Roads - Original Version
Stay
songs.comments: Mikky's vocals sound a little tense. I actually like the way the chorus differs each time it comes. It swaps singers for the second chorus and Rhianna adds a spectacular embellishment to the final one for the outro.

songs.name: Lover
songs.comments: Some pretty awkward lyrics such as "I've loved you three summers now" and most of the bridge. I think a few scores could go down here but they're on the edge.

songs.name: 1Train (feat. Kendrick Lamar, Joey Bada$$, Yelawolf, Danny Brown, Action Bronson & Big K.R.I.T.)
songs.artists: A$AP Rocky, Kendrick Lamar, Joey Bada$$, Yelawolf, Danny Brown, Action Bronson, Big K.R.I.T.
songs.comments: Not a huge fan of the repeated pauses in Kendrick's verse. The content of the pause lacks the power to justify it. Not sure if it's stylistic but Joey seems to slightly lag behind the beat. Background is repetitive.

songs.name: One Summer Dream
songs.comments: A lot of "one summer dream" in the lyrics. Vocals in the opener are good but they sound awkward and crude compared to the background for most of the song.

songs.name: Can't Get It out of My Head
About You
songs.album: Being Funny In A Foreign Language

songs.name: Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da - Remastered 2009
songs.comments: Lyrics are a bit nonsensical. I don't know whether it's weird or interesting that they swap Molly and Desmond. There are occasionally these mouth sound effects that seem to overload the mic
Sections connect well. Rapping seems pretty good, maybe a little flat. I don't like the decision to end the song by just repeating the chorus, it feels very boring.
songs.name: edamame
Can't You Hear Me Knocking - 2009 Mix
December, 1963 (Oh What a Night!)
songs.comments: I cannot believe that this is the drummer singing. His voice is absolutely gorgeous.

songs.name: Ain't It Fun
songs.comments: The gospel choir in the background is cool. I like the drums and bass. It's very repetitive though, and the lyrics are pretty simplistic.

songs.name: Ave Maria
songs.comments: Although she's a great vocalist, I generally just feel this interpretation of the song feels hollow and shallow compared to the original. I don't like the percussion that sounds like snapping in the background.

songs.name: Pink Pony Club
songs.comments: I like the lyrics but they also repeat a bit too much for me to raise the score.
songs.album: The Rise and Fall of a Midwest Princess

songs.name: Good Time
songs.comments: Same criticism of Adam Young's vocals, he over pronounces words. I like the high energy of the song. I don't like how there are only two real distinct verses.

songs.name: Just Give Me a Reason (feat. Nate Ruess)
Boy Blue
songs.comments: A lot of distinct verses in the lyrics and there is a story

songs.name: Viva La Vida
songs.comments: I always thought it was "sweep the streets that I used to own" but he actually just extends the "I" with no "that." I like how the verses show a story progression.
songs.album: Viva La Vida or Death and All His Friends
Descendants Of The Sun Pt.3 (Original Television Soundtrack)
songs.name: This Love
S.O.S D'un Terrien en detresse - Live
songs.comments: There's a better version on youtube. His pronunciation is much better there and his vocals blend much better. I'd give that one a 10 in vocals and not dock on cohesion. The song builds well though.

songs.artists: Kali Uchis, Tyler, The Creator, Bootsy Collins
songs.name: After The Storm (feat. Tyler, The Creator & Bootsy Collins)
songs.comments: I like the background. Drums and bass are great. Not a big fan of the lyrics. A little basic, a little all over the place, and generally they don't fit well with the mood of the song.
Background feels very basic, could have a lower score. Chorus is very similar aside from a few added parts in the background every time.
songs.name: Blank Space

songs.comments: The rhymes are creative but disjointed. There's a bit of a lisp, not sure if that's specific to this song because of the name. Structure is just one massive run which makes listening to it feels like reading a massive block of unformatted text.
songs.name: Saliva

songs.comments: Love the instrumental. A lot of chorus but the delivery does vary a bit. I really like the verse with "how can you stay."
songs.name: Honky Cat

songs.album: Melt My Eyez See Your Future
songs.comments: There's a sound at the beginning like someone is chewing metal.
songs.name: Walkin

songs.comments: Repetitive and dominated by the chorus. Lyrics are pretty basic.
songs.name: Late Night Talking
Remember Summer Days
songs.comments: I like the song but it kind of lacks an overall direction. Some sections are directly repeated.

songs.name: Havana (feat. Young Thug)
songs.comments: Gets very repetitive in the second half. Lyrics in the rap verse are completely unrelated. It feels like there are a few different styles in the background that don't quite fit together.

songs.album: Love Is a Four Letter Word (Deluxe Edition)
songs.name: 93 Million Miles

songs.comments: Lyrics are a little cheesy. Still, there is a story.
songs.name: Love Story
U & I
songs.comments: I like the drum fills. Vocals are very powerful. Brass is cool too. I think some scores could be raised on this song.
Not really sure what's up with the percussion on this one. Sounds kind of like what beatboxers are trying to imitate. Maybe a heartbeat? I feel like the last chorus was a strange decision.
songs.name: human
Only the Good Die Young
songs.comments: I kind of feel like the lower instruments are too quiet on this one
I love the little drum fills. I'll keep saying it though, still too much chorus on all of these songs with no variation. It was a pretty good transition out of the chorus into the ending though
songs.name: Still into You
Love On Top
songs.comments: Unreal vocals. I think the key change stuff at the end is interesting but it gets a little repetitive and the fade out ending feels lazy
The song was going somewhere during the line "if you should miss" and then it just killed all motion to go back to the chorus and meander to the end.
songs.name: There's Always Something There to Remind Me
songs.album: Soul Treasures of Amy, Mala, & Bell Records (1963-1969)

songs.name: Someone Like You
songs.comments: The repeating chorus makes up far too much of the song in my opinion
Chorus repeats too many times in my opinion
songs.name: Marry You

songs.comments: There's an electronic sound effect in the background that starts freaking out at the end of some of the choruses and sounds very odd.
songs.name: American Boy
Africa
songs.comments: Background vocals in the last chorus are nice. Lyrics feel a little nonsensical and there's nothing particularly special about the structure.
Structure is pretty simplistic, just four verses with choruses between them. I didn't deduct from flow because the song is still dominated by distinct verses.
songs.name: Gorgeous
I Guess That's Why They Call It The Blues

songs.album: Come A Little Bit Closer: The Best Of Jay & The Americans
songs.name: Come A Little Bit Closer
New Face
songs.comments: Maybe gets a little repetitive. I didn't deduct anything.

songs.name: R U Mine?
songs.comments: That guitar riff goes pretty hard honestly. The beginning is a bit trippy because it kind of baits you into thinking he's going to come in on a different beat than he does. I like the first verse though. The end of the bridge almost sounds like the outro.

songs.name: Mayonaka no Door / Stay With Me
Only Girl (In The World)
songs.comments: Interesting how the chorus shortens every time. The second chorus is the most confusing, where it goes from "one who understands" to "knows your heart." I kind just don't like how the song has three virtually identical peaks.

songs.name: 沉默是金
songs.comments: Vocals sound slightly flat. I don't love the structure, there's a short intro and outro and aside from that there are three sections that repeat once each in the same order. There's very little variance.

songs.name: World's Smallest Violin
songs.comments: I like the theme of the song. Some of the lyrics sound a bit casual, but I suppose that fits with the overall feel of the song? The instrumental breaks are odd. The outro is a really cool concept though.

songs.name: X-Wing - Cold Blooded Soul Version
songs.comments: I really like his flow (lyrical flow and overall song flow are different). The background is actually pretty interesting too, some pretty unique chords there
songs.album: Melt My Eyez See Your Future (The Extended Edition)

songs.name: Money Trees
songs.comments: It sounds like Jay Rock drags a little in his verse. He takes a lot of breaths too. There just isn't a whole lot going on in the background. Rap songs are often like this though, it's just a track put on repeat.

songs.name: Raspberry Beret
songs.album: Around The World In A Day

songs.comments: Kind of repetitive. Vocals kind of stick out a bit. I don't really like the way the last line of the bridge was delivered.
songs.name: Love Someone

songs.comments: Vocals might have a bit too much energy considering this is about someone dying. Cohesion could arguably be lowered for that.
songs.name: See You Again (feat. Charlie Puth)

songs.comments: Personally I think the lyrics are kind of a vibe but objectively they are repetitive and nonsensical.
songs.name: Barbara Ann
Have You Ever Seen The Rain
Monster
songs.comments: Some of the lyrics are good but overall there are just a lot of mediocre word choices. "Introvert," "mean," and "crazy bitch" are a few examples. Even the "mmm" instead of an actual word. Some phrases are oddly short.

songs.name: Hooked On A Feeling
songs.album: Hooked On A Feeling - 40th Anniversary Collection

songs.name: Hey Ya!
songs.comments: The lyrics from the first half of the song don't align with the lyrics from the second half

songs.name: (I Can't Get No) Satisfaction - Mono
songs.comments: Theme is pretty repetitive

songs.name: Mr. Blue Sky
songs.comments: This song does a very good job of capturing an upbeat happy feeling as a part of the Concerto for a Rainy Day. I feel like the chorus and post-chorus feel disjointed and kill the momentum of the song though, probably because the percussion stops.

songs.name: You Shook Me All Night Long
songs.comments: Score might be a little too high but vocals background and cohesion were on the edge so I decided to bump them up.

songs.name: Tiny Dancer
songs.comments: The vocals have a sound (an echo?) that makes them feel so lonely. Incredibly iconic piano riff. The first time the pre-chorus comes is amazing, it's a great transition into the higher energy section. I wish the second half didn't repeat so much stuff.
Bridge was very odd but it transitioned really well into the final chorus.
songs.name: Disturbia

songs.comments: The audience noises in the background kind of interrupt what feels like a very intimate duet. I think a dedicated outro would've improved this song. In fact, the song generally feels incomplete.
songs.name: Shallow

songs.comments: Very angsty lyrics, I get a lot of secondhand embarrassment.
songs.name: In My Mind

songs.comments: Lyrics are a bit corny but there are good ones and bad ones. I like the line "I'm only a man with a candle to guide me" and I don't like the line "would you be scared." There aren't any new developments in the song in the second half.
songs.name: Monster
Soul Kitchen
songs.comments: The song has a kind of "fuzzy" sound that makes you feel the idea of something stumbling around in a haze. The outro calls back to the first verse which is nice.

songs.album: Magic In The Hamptons (feat. Lil Yachty)
songs.name: Magic In The Hamptons (feat. Lil Yachty)
songs.comments: Ends abruptly. The song is supposed to be laid back it feels but the vocals still sound kind of lazy. Lyrics are a strange mix of trying to sound genuine while also being very crass.

songs.name: My Way - 2008 Remastered
songs.comments: To be fully honest I personally don't love this song that much but I feel when I assess each category it performs exceedingly well.
A LOT of repetition in the lyrics. They do change the way they sing the chorus though. I almost think vocal score could be higher.
songs.name: Like I'm Gonna Lose You (feat. John Legend)
Sway
songs.comments: Although the repeated sections are executed different, there are essentially no unique lyrics outside of them

songs.name: All Along the Watchtower
songs.comments: Lyric score could probably be raised.

songs.name: Smooth Criminal - 2012 Remaster

songs.comments: Vocals are a little too aggressive in the pre-chorus I feel, especially after the intro was very calm. It does feel a little odd how it peaks in the pre-chorus then goes down for the actual chorus? Background feels very basic.
Main criticisms, bridge is a bit random and the song is pretty repetitive. The lyrics are also feels a little random or generic. The song peaks really well.
songs.name: Summer and Lightning

songs.comments: "These are words that go together well" isn't a great line in my opinion. Lyrics get a little repetitive too. Flow score could go down but at least some of the words vary and the outro was pretty nice.
songs.name: Michelle - Remastered 2009

songs.comments: Structure isn't great. There are only two distinct sections, one is repeated three times. The delivery is changed slightly. The background interacts very well with the vocals. Score is a bit too high on this one.
songs.name: 最浪漫的事
songs.album: 我的愛 我的夢 我的家

songs.comments: I wish there were more unique verses man.
songs.name: King And Lionheart

songs.comments: Really unique melody. Vocals are a little unconventional, you would expect them to be a little more delicate considering the rest of the song. It kind of fits with the background though.
songs.name: Here With Me

songs.album: My Head Is An Animal (10th Anniversary Edition)
songs.comments: Lyrics are beautiful and haunting. I do almost feel like the last chorus went the wrong way maybe. I think it should've quietly died down instead of trying to climax. Strangely Spotify says the line is "dry as the walls" instead of "white as the walls."
songs.name: Sugar in a Bowl
Runaway Baby
songs.comments: Really nice riff. Credit where it's due, the line "there's only one carrot and they all gotta share it" is good. Having "runaway" in the name even though the song says "run away" is interesting. A bit repetitive and it just ends on another chorus.

songs.name: Belize (feat. MF DOOM)
songs.artists: Danger Mouse, Black Thought, MF DOOM

songs.name: 怒放的生命
songs.comments: I think the YouTube version is better. Chorus gets repeated A LOT. Banger chorus but still repetitive. Because it's live there are a lot more small errors in the vocals. I love it in rock songs when they tell the band to go again though.

I've heard the criticism that their voice is a bit "whiny" here but I think it fits. The whole song is on the same page about the character being a bit pathetic. I don't hate the flow but there are four repeated choruses.
songs.name: Stay With Me
Line Without a Hook
songs.comments: That "craving" stuck out a lot lol. His voice sounds a bit timid, which suits a lot of the song but not some of these aggressive entrances. Some strange choices for the melody at the bridge? I like that I can feel what he was going for.

songs.name: Poker Face
songs.comments: Lyrics and delivery in the intro are incredible. Aside from that it gets a bit repetitive. The synth around the middle is very disorienting with headphones on.

songs.name: She's Always a Woman
songs.comments: I feel like this should be higher but it’s kind of basic. Maybe I’m wrong.
Lyrics are definitely a little weird in isolation but they fit well with the vibe of the song. Lyrics are a little repetitive and the song doesn't really go anywhere
songs.name: Walk This Way

songs.comments: Had to deduct a bit for the lyrics. 56709 is repeated a lot and it's just not a great lyric. Still kind of works though
songs.name: テレフォン・ナンバー

songs.album: Love Grows (Where My Rosemary Goes) & Other Gems
songs.name: Love Grows (Where My Rosemary Goes)
Love Flew Away
songs.comments: The parts blend well. You can feel that the song has a direction as it rises and falls.

songs.name: Long Cool Woman (In a Black Dress) - 1999 Remaster

songs.comments: Structure isn't great, just an intro and two choruses.
songs.name: 一翦梅
Nobody Gets Me
songs.comments: The sad longing vocals don't really fit with some of the incredibly crass lyrics. The pitch correction, especially during the turns, is a bit over the top in my opinion, though I assume it's stylistic.

songs.album: Golden Melodies: Songs of the New Era Vol. 1 (Jin Se De Xuan Lv: Dang Dai Yuan Chuang Shu Qing Ge Qu Yi)
songs.name: Heavenly Road (Tian Lu)
songs.comments: That last crazy turn at the end sounded a bit out of control to me. I feel like the instrumental is lacking a bit of percussion. Lyrics sound good but they are a bit repetitive.

Not sure if I like the vocals or not. The way he sings sounds lazy, which matches the laid back theme of the song, but also just sounds kind of grating. Bridge isn't great. Background is pretty basic. A bit repetitive.
songs.name: Young Dumb & Broke

songs.comments: The mix of hoarseness and desperation in the vocals is very unique. The lyrics are extremely repetitive.
songs.name: Twist And Shout - Remastered 2009
She's Gone
songs.comments: Four distinct verses and each one has lyrics that express powerful feelings of grief and sorrow. A lot of chorus admittedly. There are ups and downs in the song but overall it climbs to the climax in the outro. The percussion in the background is great.

I get that the lyrics are supposedly related to WW2 but some of the word choices aren't great. There's so much focus on the verses that the climax doesn't have lyrics which makes it feel less meaningful?
songs.name: Dirty Paws

songs.comments: This was a pretty confusing one to grade. The instrumental and vocals have a lot of raw emotion. The pre chorus and chorus still make up too much of the song.
songs.name: Smells Like Teen Spirit

songs.comments: The lyrics just start repeating in the second half. Granted, the execution is different, but not having any new unique lyrics feels like a mistake. I debated on raising the background score, still not sure.
songs.album: Man On The Moon: The End Of Day
songs.name: Pursuit Of Happiness (Nightmare)

songs.comments: A surprisingly good song? Although the chorus repeats a lot, the execution varies and more parts are added throughout the song.
songs.name: All About That Bass

songs.comments: I don't like how it just repeats the earlier section and lines at the end. Everything before the chorus (the section where "blackbird fly" repeats) is really good.
songs.name: Blackbird - Remastered 2009

songs.artists: Andrew Lloyd Webber, Patrick Wilson, Emmy Rossum
songs.album: The Phantom Of The Opera (Original Motion Picture Soundtrack)
songs.name: All I Ask Of You - From 'The Phantom Of The Opera' Motion Picture
7 Years
songs.comments: Not personally a huge fan of this song but it does a lot of things right. The flow is great because of the theme of age and it also calls back to the beginning at the end. This also gives it a lot of unique lyrics. I'm probably underrating it because of my bias.

songs.name: 紅豆
songs.comments: Seems like a lot of canto pop songs have the formula of slowly adding instruments to make the next chorus peak higher. Not the most revolutionary but definitely not bad.
Some parts of the background are a little repetitive but overall it's good.
songs.name: Bad - 2012 Remaster
BLACK BALLOONS | 13LACK 13ALLOONZ [FEAT. TWELVE'LEN & GOLDLINK | TWELVE'LEN + GOLDL1NK]
songs.comments: Not a big fan of the verse by Goldlink

songs.name: Misty
songs.comments: Vocals feel very technical. Really nice lyrics, as expected since it's a jazz standard. The song has a rising and falling motion. Nothing special about cohesion I don't think, the background mostly is just getting out of the way of the vocals.
Ending could've been better, it was a bit abrupt.
songs.name: Love On The Brain

songs.comments: The quality of her voice is really good for this song. I admittedly don't like how much the chorus repeats. Some of the lyrics are good, others are a little corny.  It feels like there was the idea to have the song build a lot but it never got there.
songs.name: King

songs.comments: Pretty solid song but maybe a bit basic? Words like "stupid" and "dumb" feel a bit pedestrian. Vocals would be a bit better without the slight accent. I like the bridge a lot. I do not like how the song ends suddenly after a repeated chorus.
songs.name: Cupid - Twin Version

songs.comments: Lyrics are pretty odd. Background score could arguably be raised, it was a pretty fire guitar solo.
songs.name: Peace Frog
Sunday Morning
songs.comments: Bridge is a little odd but it recovers well into the next section

songs.name: Forever - Single Version
songs.comments: Very short and simple in terms of flow and lyrics. I didn't want to lower lyric score since the song is so short anyway, but you could argue they repeat and are overly simplistic. I thought it was fine.

songs.name: The Adults Are Talking
songs.comments: The bridge is incredible. Lyrics are mixed. Lines like "you want me to do it the same way as you," "I don't want anything," and "I don't want anyone" don't seem to fit with "I know you think of me when you think of her."
Cohesion score might be too high on this one
songs.name: arms

songs.comments: Lyrics are a little basic and cheesy. A few lines sound like they needed a few more syllables, like "for that night" and "needed you most." Instrumental is also pretty basic.
songs.name: Say You Won't Let Go

songs.comments: Lyrics are repetitive and don't contribute much. I personally don't mind the instrumental but it is pretty long.
songs.name: Light My Fire

songs.comments: I do like how much "personality" this song has. Parts get added throughout the song which helps the flow. I could see an argument that the cohesion score should be raised.
songs.name: Shake It Off
The Long And Winding Road - Remastered 2015
偏偏喜歡你
songs.comments: An intro and two choruses isn't great, but even just the short outro improves the flow a bit.
songs.artists: Danny Chan, Rico Fung and David at Studio A, Tom Brown

songs.comments: Lyrics are overall pretty solid on this one but I will mention that I don’t like when lyrics include a specific number of unknown significance like “twenty-three”
songs.name: Serendipity

songs.comments: I like the song but it is a little confusing between some of the edgy and nonsensical lyrics and extremely upbeat instrumental. Structure is also a little weird with the repeated "the mask that you wore" section into an instrumental.
songs.name: Easy Ride
Uptown Girl
songs.comments: The background vocals add a lot
I don't really like the percussion in the background (clapping I think?). It feels a bit out of place to me and makes the song feel too casual
songs.name: I Wish You Love

songs.comments: Some of the lyrics definitely aren't great, like "I haven't written a sad song" and "finally pick a movie, then we'll fall asleep." The shift from present to future is also very sudden. I like the ending though.
songs.name: Best Friend

songs.comments: Lyrics are a mixed bag. I don't really like "case of fragile glass," I think it's too direct. "A year and forty days since you picked me up and swept me away" is very specific and the rhyming feels tacky.
songs.name: Fragile
Happy - From "Despicable Me 2"
songs.comments: The song gets very repetitive at the end. I honestly feel like it would've been better if it ended at the 2:43 mark instead of going for another repetition.

songs.name: Kiss
songs.comments: Vocals are a little odd, might be an acquired taste. Background is uninspiring for most of the song except for the bridge. You could argue all the parts fit together with the theme? Overall, a very weird song to grade, very unconventional.
songs.album: Parade - Music from the Motion Picture Under the Cherry Moon

songs.name: Hello
songs.comments: The background builds throughout the song but it does generally feel very simplistic and underwhelming to me. A dedicated outro would've made this song much better.

songs.name: Paint It, Black
songs.comments: I feel that the low sections aren't sad enough and the high sections don't sound angry enough to match the story in the lyrics. Lyrics are a little edgy but understandably so given the setting. Sounds like the audio bugs a bit around the 2 minute mark.

songs.name: It's Still Rock and Roll to Me
Dernière danse
songs.comments: I don't like the kind of techno style that comes in at the second half. Her voice also sounds like it's being garbled by pitch correction.
Drums are pretty cool. I didn't like some of the vocals that sounded more "spoken" and a few of the sound effects. Generally the song feels very unique and interesting though.
Lyrics feel a bit nonsensical and repetitive
songs.name: Love Me Two Times
Faded
songs.comments: Definitely not my preferred music genre but I gotta admit it's pretty hype

songs.artists: Daft Punk, Pharrell Williams, Nile Rodgers
songs.name: Get Lucky (feat. Pharrell Williams and Nile Rodgers)

songs.comments: For its purpose the lyrics were obviously effectively but outside of that context it kind of feels like I'm listening to a scuffle that I have no part in. Background is basic and repetitive.
songs.name: Not Like Us
Truce
songs.comments: I find his voice a bit grating but you could argue it also has a lot of emotion.

songs.name: L.A. Woman
songs.comments: The bridge is a bit odd but it leads well into the next section.

songs.name: This Love
songs.comments: A lot of chorus but it changes at the end and I love the bridge.

songs.name: Roar
songs.comments: Each progressive chorus actually does noticeably peak higher than the last. The added background vocals in the last chorus are actually very nice. I do wish there were more distinct lyrics and verses but generally the lyrics are solid.

songs.name: Wet Dreamz
songs.comments: Funny story with a great twist. Background is repetitive. The story improves the flow.
Not a fan of the second verse. Pronunciation isn't bad but vocals would be improved if it was better.
songs.name: seasons

songs.comments: I don't really like the pre-chorus, it feels a bit out of place with the rest of the song. I lowered flow a bit because of that combined with the chorus being a bit repetitive.
songs.name: My House
On Top Of The World
songs.comments: I absolutely love the transition into the bridge on this song.

songs.name: Dreamer's Ball - Remastered 2011
songs.comments: I really don't like the bridge. I think it completely ruins the vibe of the song for me as something very bittersweet. Aside from that I really like how the song sounds a bit confused on whether it's a bit more upbeat or melancholy. Kind of like denial?
Only criticism of the lyrics is that I think the last section at the end could've been its own unique verse instead of repeating the second verse.
songs.name: Good Life
Feel It Still
songs.comments: Pretty repetitive chorus. Song also does give a feeling like it went nowhere. It ended pretty much where it started but because that was a repeated section it doesn't have the same impact as a callback.

songs.name: Dancing With A Stranger (with Normani)
songs.comments: I feel like I waited for the song to go somewhere but it never did. Vocals in the first verse were pretty impressive. Background is exceedingly bland.

songs.album: Songs In The Key Of Life
songs.name: Isn't She Lovely
songs.comments: The song drags on a bit with the audio from what I assume is the birth of his child playing, which is also too loud.

songs.name: I Just Called To Say I Love You
songs.album: At The Close Of A Century

songs.name: Cool Cat - Remastered 2011
songs.comments: Crazy falsetto. I absolutely love the instrumental on this one but the score might be a bit high.

songs.name: Rude
songs.comments: Pretty repetitive. The line "why you gotta be so rude" also just sounds a bit crude, which I suppose fits the character here, but still just isn't nice to listen to.

songs.name: Baby Blue - Remastered 2010
songs.comments: He cuts the phrases pretty short. I guess if they were too long it wouldn't fit with the high energy background? The lyrics definitely have a progression, kind of towards acceptance. Maybe a little too high energy for the lyrics.
Could have benefitted from an outro in my opinion. The song is also just dominated by sections that get repeated.
songs.name: Mirrors - Radio Edit
Better When You're High
songs.comments: The chorus is always exactly the same and the lyrics in the rap verses feel overly crude. It feels like there was some unexplored potential with the bittersweet sound in the chorus.

songs.name: You Say
songs.comments: "The only thing that matters now is everything You think of me" is a terrifying line. It's pretty repetitive.

songs.name: Say Something
songs.artists: A Great Big World, Christina Aguilera
songs.comments: A very good example of building throughout the song and changing the delivery on the same lyric

songs.name: Wouldn't It Be Nice
songs.comments: Background vocals do a lot for this song

songs.name: Footloose
songs.album: Yesterday, Today, Tomorrow - The Greatest Hits Of Kenny Loggins

songs.comments: I do like how the instruments come in during the second half, and how the song concludes the way it started.
songs.name: 因為愛情

songs.comments: Did they just invent the phrase "I'm not into bacon?" Lyrics are kind of hilarious but the character is supposed to be upset. Song is very upbeat? Bridge is great.
songs.name: I Found A Girl

songs.comments: The vocals sound a little garbled in the distinct verses. It's quite repetitive. Not a fan of the Snow White line, it feels petty and the message of that story doesn't seem very similar to the one in this song.
songs.name: Sit Still, Look Pretty
24K Magic
songs.comments: Difficult song to grade. I kind of just don't like repeated sections. Maybe it's because of the energy level of the song but I feel like even one direct repetition has me wonder a bit why I'm listening to the same thing again.
I like the lyrics in the first two verses a lot. The vocals very dynamic which makes the lyrics feel less repetitive, especially in the outro.
songs.name: Somebody To Love - Remastered 2011
songs.album: A Day At The Races (Deluxe Remastered Version)

songs.comments: The vocals are excellent but they do stick out a little bit. I actually love the background vocals in the outro.
songs.name: Who's Lovin' You

songs.comments: Lyrics are a little simplistic. Maybe a bit too much repetition of certain words, even in the unique verses, but generally lyrics are solid. The song doesn't really go anywhere at the end unfortunately.
songs.name: Here Comes The Sun - Remastered 2009

songs.album: The Very Best of Frankie Valli & The 4 Seasons
songs.comments: Lyrics are a bit repetitive but good
songs.name: Can't Take My Eyes off You
Don't Ask Me Why
songs.comments: Flow score reduced because I feel like the bridge doesn't fit perfectly and because the song keeps the same format until the last verse

songs.name: Dude (Looks Like A Lady)
songs.comments: I promise the lyrics aren't transphobic. Still, they're a bit awkward and repetitive.

songs.name: Spread Your Wings - Remastered 2011
songs.comments: Some lyrics like "Emerald Bar" are a bit random. It's a story about a character but the song is too short to flesh it out. I do like the simplicity of the chorus lyrics and lines like "you've got not real ambition" though.
songs.album: News Of The World (Deluxe Remastered Version)

songs.comments: I like the theme of the lyrics being advice. There are a lot of unique lines.
songs.name: Tell Her About It

songs.comments: This song is all over the place. The third verse and bridge are completely different and the lyrics are more nonsensical. I do like how it returns to the same theme as the first half at the end though. Scoring on this one is very questionable.
songs.name: Bohemian Rhapsody

songs.comments: The dreaded 2 verse 3 chorus flow. And no real bridge. At least they introduce some more instruments later I guess.
songs.name: a thousand years
drive ME crazy!
songs.comments: I like the first section a lot more than the rest
Very nonsensical lyrics. Ends pretty suddenly.
songs.name: Illusions in G Major

songs.comments: The vocals carry a lot of emotion. Lyrics are beautiful. Small criticism, the transition from "wish you were here" to "we're just two lost souls" is a bit awkward.
songs.name: Wish You Were Here

songs.comments: The lyrics in general are very good, but that one line "Faded like The Beatles on 'Hey Jude'" is disastrous. It doesn't help that the melody is disrupted and paused on that line, which further emphasizes it. I made some pretty harsh deductions for those.
songs.name: Shangri-La

songs.comments: Very repetitive. Chorus repeats four times and the chorus itself is one line repeated four times. Even the bridge just repeats part of the first verse. The few distinct lyrics are pretty basic. Lyrics pretty much only accessorize the beat.
songs.name: We Found Love
Born This Way
songs.comments: I like the idea but some of the lyrics feel a little too on the nose maybe? The bridge also messes with the consistent rhythm a bit in my opinion, maybe some kind of a dance break?
Very strange kind of "squiggly?" sound effect in the background around 1:12. Some phrases are delivered a bit strangely, some weird ideas with the rhyming. Bridge repeats lyrics from the intro.
songs.name: 400 Lux

songs.comments: Some phrases are a little choppy, I guess I don't think drawing them out would sound better. I like the structure, three unique verses and an outro. I could see flow score being raised.
songs.name: The Way Life's Meant to Be
-Error
songs.comments: You can definitely hear the strain for the high notes but it's still insanely impressive
I don't like the heavily autotuned section but aside from that he's clearly a good singer.
songs.name: Some Nights
Sweet Is the Night
songs.comments: Some of the phrases cut off a bit too sharply in the vocals. It makes the vocals feel a little out of sync with the background during the unique verses. A lot of the lyrics are kind of basic or repetitive.

songs.album: What Was I Made For? [From The Motion Picture "Barbie"]
songs.name: What Was I Made For? [From The Motion Picture "Barbie"]
songs.comments: The vocals are nice but almost a little too breathy even if that's the intended style.

songs.name: Last Train to London
songs.comments: Not too much going in the lyrics or flow but the instrumental is pretty infectious.
All the parts work together to create the kind of dingy atmosphere. I do like how the song builds but I can't raise the flow because it repeats the same pattern so many times
songs.name: Piano Man

songs.comments: I keep hearing "que paso" at the start of the chorus
songs.name: You Were Beautiful

songs.comments: I like how the instruments get added one by one. Bass drop was pretty underwhelming. Bridge moves into the last chorus well. I like the added backing vocals in the last chorus. Chorus does feel a little out of place and is just lacking bass.
songs.name: I Knew You Were Trouble.
Set Fire to the Rain
songs.comments: Every chorus is virtually identical.
I really like the lines "Come back and haunt me" and "do not speak as loud as my heart." The song builds upwards throughout.
songs.album: A Rush of Blood to the Head
songs.name: The Scientist

songs.comments: The song is very long and meanders a bit. The sections that are clearly designed for dance breaks in a live performance don't help the flow either.
songs.name: The Way You Make Me Feel - 2012 Remaster
Cake By The Ocean
songs.comments: I took a bit off of flow because I didn't like how it transitioned from chorus into an incredibly short bridge back into a chorus that was almost identical. A lot of scores here are on the upper edge though.

songs.name: Beast Of Burden - Remastered 1994
songs.comments: A lot of the lyrics feel vague or erratic.
Beautiful story in the lyrics that has a clear flow of time.
songs.name: When She Loved Me - From "Toy Story 2" / Soundtrack Version
Afraid of Love
songs.comments: Lyrics are very generic, nothing really interesting there. Instrumental is great though.

songs.name: Asleep Among Endives
songs.comments: Song length lowered flow score

songs.name: Love Never Felt So Good (Original Version)
songs.comments: Although he does change the way he sings the sections when he repeats, the song still has a very odd structure where it essentially repeats three times with no bridge
I generally like this song. I like the line "Oh, what a shame that you came here with someone." Only complaint is that the chorus repeats too often without much variation.
songs.name: Die Young

songs.album: Jeff Lynne's ELO - Alone in the Universe
songs.name: Ain't It a Drag

songs.comments: I feel like it almost sounds a little too upbeat? I do like the line "would you feel a thing if you saw me right now." I don't like how that version of the chorus gets repeated though, it makes it feel less impactful. The bridge also doesn't quite fit.
songs.name: Shouldn't Be

songs.artists: Mac Miller, Empire Of The Sun
songs.name: The Spins
Red Wine Supernova
songs.album: The Rise and Fall of a Midwest Princess
songs.comments: Solid mix of lyrics that I like and don't like so I'd say it evens out. Vocals at the end are really good but they aren't that good throughout the whole song

songs.name: Fly Me To The Moon - 2008 Remastered
Come and Get Your Love - Single Version
Killer Queen - Remastered 2011
songs.comments: The distortion on his voice during "Dynamite with a laser beam" is odd. The song also feels a bit choppy.
This is a hard one. I think vocals, background and cohesion all could debatably be increased
songs.name: Space Song
Start Me Up - Remastered 2009
songs.comments: A good example of how even a small change to a line in the chorus can improve the lyrics. Even so I could see the lyrics and flow being lower
I like everything except the chorus which kind of sticks out
songs.name: Latitude 88 North

songs.comments: Beginning almost reminds me of Fazers. I like the background a lot. I feel like just repeating the first verse multiple times at the end was pretty lazy. Not a big fan of how the line "now me, Groggs and P doin' the three man weave, though" sounds.
songs.name: Three Man Weave
Moves Like Jagger - Studio Recording From "The Voice" Performance
songs.comments: The background vocals by Christina Aguilera in the last chorus help a lot.

songs.name: Starboy
songs.comments: Ending so many lines with "ah" is pretty interesting at the beginning but gets a little old as it gets repeated. I like the line "I switch up my cup, I kill any pain." It changes the tone a bit after so many lines of boasting. A bit repetitive.

songs.album: Ultimate Big Band Collection: Glenn Miller
songs.name: Chattanooga Choo Choo

songs.comments: Nice outro. Kind of saves the flow. Could argue that vocal score should be higher.
songs.name: We Are Young (feat. Janelle Monáe)

songs.comments: A bit of an odd feeling from how upbeat the background is? Lyrics are more sad and the vocals sound like they're far away, maybe to create a bittersweet feeling? It's on the edge in terms of repetitiveness for me. Distinct verses are good.
songs.name: Lovefool

songs.album: News Of The World (Deluxe Remastered Version)
songs.name: We Are The Champions - Remastered 2011
songs.comments: I think I associate this song too much with sporting events which makes it feel very shallow. With that being said, I'm not sure how much depth there could be to the line "we are the champions." Seems pretty blatant what the song wants to say.
Some very odd sections to this song
songs.name: Jungle
Righteous Minds
songs.comments: I don't dislike the rapping but it sounds like rushes a bit at some parts. Chorus repeats a lot. Backing track isn't bad but it's also repetitive as usual.
I like how drums and strings are added as the song goes on. Chorus repeats a few times at the end but it's noticeable changing and building.
songs.name: All Out of Love
Million Reasons
songs.comments: "Giving me a million reasons" just doesn't sound great when repeated I feel, probably because "million" is just an awkward word. Vocals are pretty good on this one though.

songs.name: Nightrider
songs.comments: Melody is a little odd at some points. The introduction is a little awkward too. It ends on another chorus without going anywhere really.
Lyrics feel a little surface level maybe for such a heavy topic. Background is just an infinite loop and it feels more repetitive because it's a sample.
songs.name: death bed (coffee for your head)

songs.comments: I love the lines "I'm never gonna be the same again now I've seen the way it's got to end." Aside from that "strange magic" gets repeated WAY too many times. The melody there is also a little odd which doesn't help.
songs.name: Strange Magic
You May Be Right
songs.comments: The execution almost sounds too clean for the vibe of the song

songs.name: I Want To Break Free - Remastered 2011
songs.comments: Unsure if I like how different the feeling of the lyrics are from the vocals or not, it definitely has its charm. The distinct verses definitely indicate flow over time of getting over someone. Very conflicted over scores for almost every category here.

songs.name: ocean eyes
songs.comments: The reversed vocals at the bridge is a little tacky. The chorus repeats a lot but some of the lyrics are also pretty nice so it about evens out. Vocals in the final chorus are absolutely gorgeous.
The piano accompaniment fits really well with the vocals. Vocals feel very free and unleashed. Lyrics fit well with the theme but can be a little silly and they repeat.
songs.name: Don't Stop Me Now - Remastered 2011

songs.comments: The background builds a bit. You could argue the background score should be higher.
songs.name: 約定

songs.comments: The vocal score feels slightly too high and the background score slightly too low so I figure it kind of balances out
songs.name: Southern Nights
Count on Me
songs.comments: Background grows throughout. I don't like the line "that's what friends are s'posed to do" line but the lyrics overall are solid.
The "But she's no drag, just watch the way she walks" line is pretty fire. Some lyrics just feel a little awkward though, like "fashionably" and "twentieth century fox."
songs.name: Twentieth Century Fox
